create.name: Paścimapāḍā
create.about: The residence of Śrī Govinda Kavirāja, Śrīnivāsa Ācārya's disciple and Rāmacandra Kavirāja's younger brother; his father was Cirañjīva Sena and his wife Mahāmāyā-devī. A Śākta at first, he was initiated by Śrīnivāsa when ill, was healed and wrote his first song, «bhajahuṅ re mana śrī-nanda-nandana»; Jīva Gosvāmī gave him the title «Kavirāja».

create.name: Pichaladā
create.location: Fourteen miles from Tamaluka: across the Haldī river from Naraghāṭa (coordinates approximate)
create.about: On His first journey from Purī towards Vṛndāvana (by the sea route) Mahāprabhu came here and went on by boat to Pānīhāṭī. The «Pādapīṭha» Pichaladā Gauḍīya Maṭha of the Gauḍīya Vedānta Samiti is here.

create.name: Pūrvasthalī
create.location: In the western part of Navadvīpa-dhāma

create.name: Puṭiyā
create.about: King Vīrendra Nārāyaṇa of Puṭiyā was initiated by Vaiṣṇavas inspired by Śrīnivāsa Ācārya's descendants. Śrī Gaṅgāmātā Gosvāminī (Śacī-devī), a daughter of Puṭiyā's kings, took initiation from Haridāsa Gosvāmī, pūjārī of Govindadeva, did bhajana at Rādhā-kuṇḍa and then at the ruins of Sārvabhauma's house in Purī.

create.name: Śaṅkhanagara
create.location: One of the seven villages of Saptagrāma, on the Sarasvatī, near Magarāra (coordinates approximate)
create.about: The śrīpāṭa of Kālidāsa, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī's paternal uncle, who sought out Vaiṣṇavas, gave them fruits and sweets, heard hari-kathā and secretly ate their remnants — even those of Jhaḍū Ṭhākura.

create.name: Śītala-grāma
create.location: One mile north-east of Kaicara station, on the Vardhamāna–Kaṭavā line
create.about: The residence of Śrī Dhanañjaya Paṇḍita, one of the twelve gopālas (Vasudāma in Vraja), born at Pāḍagrāma in Caṭṭagrāma; he gave everything to Mahāprabhu, kept one empty pot, preached widely and installed Gaura-Nitāī and Gopīnātha here.

create.name: Tamaluka
create.about: An ancient port and royal capital. King Mayūradhvaja recognised Arjuna and Kṛṣṇa here, and Kṛṣṇa stays as Jiṣṇu-hari. After Mahāprabhu's sannyāsa, Vāsudeva Ghoṣa moved here and worshipped a deity of Mahāprabhu.

create.name: Triveṇī
create.location: Confluence of the Gaṅgā, Yamunā and Sarasvatī
create.about: When Nityānanda Prabhu lived in Saptagrāma He bathed at Triveṇī-ghāṭa.

create.name: Uddhāraṇa-pura
create.location: On the Bhāgīrathī, two miles north of Kaṭavā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Residence and samādhi of Śrī Uddhāraṇa Datta Ṭhākura, foremost of the twelve gopālas (Subāhu in Vraja), born in Kṛṣṇapura of Saptagrāma; Nityānanda Prabhu used to sit under an old neem tree nearby.

create.name: Vakreśvara
create.about: Here the sage Aṣṭāvakra did austerities; the Śvetagaṅgā and the śiva-liṅga Vakreśvara are here. Nityānanda Prabhu came here (the first place of His pilgrimage).

create.name: Vallabhapura
create.location: By Śrīrāmapura (Serampore), on the Gaṅgā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Śrī Kāśīśvara Paṇḍita and Śrī Rudra Paṇḍita lived here; their deity Śrī Rādhā-Vallabha is still worshipped. Kāśīśvara served the Gaura-Govinda deity here on Mahāprabhu's order.

create.name: Vrajarājapura
create.about: A pastime-place of Śrī Gadādhara dāsa, associate of Nityānanda Prabhu.

create.name: Eṅḍiyādaha
create.location: On the bank of the Gaṅgā
create.about: Śrī Gadādhara dāsa lived here; his temple, house and samādhi are still here. He went with Nityānanda Prabhu to preach in Bengal and made the Kazi of his village a Vaiṣṇava.
